title: Commutative algebras satisfying univariate identities with vanishing Peirce polynomial
summary: This paper introduces and studies $(2,3)$-palintropic algebras, a class of commutative algebras defined by the identity $(x^{2})^3 - (x^{3})^2 = 0$. This specific relation is the simplest generator of the $2$-dimensional space of minimal-degree evanescent identities in degree $6$, and encompasses several well-studied structures, including Jordan and medial algebras. The primary motivation for investigating these algebras lies in their trivial Peirce polynomials, which removes a priori restrictions on the spectrum of the multiplication operator associated with an idempotent.
